story.titleZh: 汉密尔顿批评法拉利缺乏规则
story.summaryZh: 在意大利大奖赛上，刘易斯·汉密尔顿与队友夏尔·勒克莱尔起步后发生碰撞，赛后汉密尔顿对法拉利车队内部缺乏规则表示不满。
story.originalTitle: 'Here there are no rules' - Hamilton calls Ferrari out
story.summaryEn: Lewis Hamilton criticized a lack of rules within the Ferrari team after an early collision with teammate Charles Leclerc compromised his Italian Grand Prix.
detailZh: 法拉利一级方程式车手刘易斯·汉密尔顿抨击了车队内部缺乏规则的问题，此前意大利大奖赛因他与队友夏尔·勒克莱尔在早段发生的事故而受到影响。
起步后不久，勒克莱尔对汉密尔顿进入第一弯（Variante del Rettifilo）的迟刹车超越做出回应，试图在弯道第二段守住位置，并在出弯时将汉密尔顿挤到砂石区，导致44号车的名次大幅下滑。
在这场被红旗打断的比赛（红旗由勒克莱尔第二圈的撞车引发）结束时，这件事沉重地压在汉密尔顿心头。他最终以第六名完赛，在旧的中性胎上苦苦挣扎，因为他没有利用虚拟安全车进行一次“免费”的进站，而基米·安东内利和马克斯·维斯塔潘都在他之前完成了这次进站。
对汉密尔顿来说这次进站本来也很勉强——虚拟安全车在安东内利和维斯塔潘驶出维修站后仅几秒就取消了——但仍有可能成功（而且法拉利本也可以在红旗期间干脆为汉密尔顿换上更硬的轮胎）。
勒克莱尔曾表示，一号弯发生的事故双方都有责任，甚至似乎把大部分责任归咎于汉密尔顿。针对他所说的“我们做得太过分了”，汉密尔顿给出了尖锐的回击：“到二号弯时我在前面。到弯心时我在前面。所以这里面没有什么‘我们’。”
当被问到法拉利车迷是否应该担心队友之间的争斗时，他的回答也暗示了对队友比赛方式的不满。
“听着，你知道的，我比赛从来不耍阴招，”他说。“我一直干净、公平地比赛，总是留出空间。所以我认为他们不用担心我。
“我加入车队以来一直努力尊重空间——绝对没有把车队置于危险之中。我坚持这一点，这就是我这边能说的全部。另一方面你得去问弗雷德·瓦塞尔。”
赛后，汉密尔顿与文字媒体的交流时间异常之长，但当被问到法拉利内部是否存在文化问题时，他予以了回击。
“我知道你们这些人想干什么！我不想陷入关于我的车队的争吵和争斗，”他说，“归根结底，我正在竭尽全力去打造这支车队，帮助它达到它需要达到的高度。”
“我们今天表现得不够好。这本已经够痛苦了，没必要再去纠缠我的车手们。他们要回家面对家人。他们真的非常、非常努力。是的，我们今天没有做对。这还不够好。但我们会回到起点重新规划。”
不过，在此之前他非常明确地表达了对贴身缠斗（轮对轮较量）没有得到约束的不满——而且，就像他在荷兰大奖赛后以及周六排位赛后所做的那样，他再次暗示车队没有为他的争冠征程投入足够的力量。
“现在才做那些决定已经太晚了，晚了很多很多个星期。所以，我能做的就是尽力出现在赛场上。”他若有所思地说。
这个周末汉密尔顿遇到了一些与勒克莱尔无关的操作性问题——不过周六他也明确表达了对勒克莱尔那侧车库的不满，因为对方的一个二段排位赛（Q2）运行计划妨碍了他自己的成绩。
当被《The 比赛》问到法拉利在操作层面丢分的问题时，他说：“归根结底这来自于高层。决策是自上而下层层传导的，所以一切要从瓦塞尔开始。”
“你能说的、能在山顶上呐喊和推动的东西终究有限。昨天（周六）我说过，我们必须审视我们的沟通方式，因为如果我们继续沿着同样的路走下去，就会得到同样的结果。”
"就是说，我们一直在得到同样的结果。我们必须做出改变，因为这对我们前进没有帮助。我认为他们是愿意接受的，我们会把这件事放到私下里讨论……可能不是下周，尤其是在下一场比赛之后，试图研究我们在流程上如何以不同的方式做事，这样同样的情况就不会一再发生。"
当谈到如何为他的争冠之路排定优先次序时，他表示重点不是让勒克莱尔让位，而是要避免类似第一个减速弯（chicane）处所发生的那种局面。
"我认为关键在于交战规则。当我在梅赛德斯的时候，我们有一份书面的交战规则。我们从没闹得特别僵。我和尼科（罗斯伯格）之间也许有过几次小摩擦。但大多数时候都很好，我是说，尤其是和瓦尔特利（博塔斯）之间……"
在他与媒体的书面访谈环节时，瓦塞尔表示他还没有和勒克莱尔详细讨论发车时的事故——而和汉密尔顿只谈了"两秒钟"。当被问及他的看法时，他坚持说："我更愿意先和他们讨论，而不是先和你们讨论。"
关于在虚拟安全车期间不进站的策略，他说：“在虚拟安全车出现前后，我们与马克斯的差距是一样的。”这里指的是一个事实：当兰斯·斯特罗尔因液压故障触发虚拟安全车时，汉密尔顿落后维斯塔潘约六到七秒，而最终比赛结束时他落后维斯塔潘10秒。
“但就我们的情况来说，如果进站，你会落在（角田裕毅）和（皮埃尔·加斯利）身后，我不确定你是否能超过他们，”瓦塞尔补充道，不过乍看之下，汉密尔顿几乎百分之百肯定能超过小红牛的赛车，而且极有可能也能重新超过加斯利。
至于赛前是否与车手们谈及争夺总冠军的形势，瓦塞尔说：“关于是否要有车队指令之类的安排，我想我能做出的最好比较是：上赛季这个时候，（奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里）正领跑迈凯伦。如果迈凯伦当时把一切都押在皮亚斯特里身上，那么马克斯·维斯塔潘就会是总冠军了。”
“但可以肯定的是，到了某个阶段，你必须做出决定。不过我认为在蒙扎之前就做决定还为时过早。现在我们有时间和车手们好好讨论了。”
汉密尔顿落后领跑车手总冠军的安东内利76分，勒克莱尔落后安东内利112分——而本赛季剩余比赛最多还有258分可以争夺。
detailEn: Ferrari Formula 1 driver Lewis Hamilton has hit out at a lack of rules within the team, following an Italian Grand Prix compromised by an early incident with team-mate Charles Leclerc.

Moments after the start, Leclerc responded to a Hamilton divebomb into Variante del Rettifilo by trying to keep position through the second part of the corner and crowding Hamilton out into the gravel on exit, which dropped the #44 car well down the order.

It weighed heavily on Hamilton's mind at the conclusion of the red flag-disrupted race (the flag triggered by Leclerc's lap-two crash), as he trundled home in sixth, struggling on used mediums after not taking a 'free' virtual safety car pitstop that both Kimi Antonelli and Max Verstappen were able to make ahead of him.

It would have been marginal for Hamilton - the VSC was lifted only a few seconds after Antonelli and Verstappen headed out of the pits - but it may have been possible (and Ferrari could have also simply fitted the harder tyre for Hamilton during the red flag).

Leclerc had suggested a joint responsibility for what happened at Turn 1, even seemingly placing most of the blame on Hamilton. In response to his claim that "we went too far", Hamilton offered a sharp rebuke: "I was ahead in Turn 2. By the apex, I was ahead. So there was no 'we' in it."
He also alluded to a dissatisfaction with his team-mate's approach to racing with his answer to the question of whether Ferrari fans should fear a team-mate feud.
"Look, you know, I don't race dirty," he said. "I've always raced clean and fairly and always left space. So I don't think they should be worried about me.

"I've come into the team and tried to be respectful of space - and definitely not put the team in jeopardy. I stand by that and that's all I can talk about, on my side. You have to speak to Fred [Vasseur] about the other side."
Hamilton spoke to the written press for an unusually long time in the aftermath of the race, though pushed back when asked whether there was a cultural issue at play at Ferrari.

"I know what you guys are trying to do! I don't want to get into arguing and fighting about my team," he said. "At the end of the day, I'm trying my hardest to make this team and help this team get to where it needs to be.

"We didn't do so well today. It's painful enough as it is, to be badgering my guys. They go home to their families. They're working really, really hard. Yes, we didn't get it right today. It isn't good enough. But we'll go back to the drawing table."

However, before that he very clearly expressed a dissatisfaction with the wheel-to-wheel racing not being reined in - and again, as he had done after the Dutch GP and after Saturday's qualifying, indicated that not enough weight had been thrown behind his title campaign.
"It's far too late for that, for those decisions to come. It's many, many weeks too late. So, all I can do is just try and turn up," he mused.

There were operational problems for Hamilton through this weekend independent of Leclerc - though he was also pointedly unhappy with Leclerc's side of the garage on Saturday over a Q2 run plan that hindered his own.
Asked by The Race about Ferrari losing points operationally, he said: "Ultimately it comes from the top. It trickles down decisions - and so, it starts with Fred.

"There's only so much you can say, so much you can push and shout from the mountaintop. Yesterday [Saturday] I said we've got to look at just how we communicate because if we continue to travel the same path, we get the same result.

"It's like, we keep getting the same result. We've got to change things because this is not helping us move forwards. I think they're receptive to it and we'll take it offline over the next...probably not for next week, but particularly after next race to try and look how we can procedurally do things different so the same thing can't keep happening."
And when it came to prioritising his title charge, he said it wasn't about moving Leclerc over but just avoiding situations like what transpired at the first chicane.

"I think it comes down to rules of engagement. When I was at Mercedes, we had a written rule of engagement. We never really, really had too bad. There was a moment maybe with me and Nico [Rosberg] a couple of times. But more often than not it was good, I mean, [especially with] Valtteri [Bottas]...

At the time of his written media session, Vasseur said he had not yet talked through the start incident with Leclerc - and just for "two seconds" with Hamilton. "I prefer to discuss with them first than with you first," he insisted when asked for his view.

On the no-stop under VSC, he said: "We had the same gap with Max before and after the VSC." This is in reference to the fact Hamilton trailed Verstappen by around six-to-seven seconds when Lance Stroll's hydraulic failure brought out the VSC, and ended up 10 seconds back from Verstappen at the finish.

"But in our case, if you pit you are behind [Yuki] Tsunoda and [Pierre] Gasly, I'm not sure that you are able to overtake them," Vasseur added, though at first glance it appears 100% certain Hamilton would've cleared the Racing Bulls, and also extremely likely he would've got back past Gasly.

As for whether the championship picture was raised with the drivers pre-race, Vasseur said: "To see if we have a team order or whatever, I think that the good comparison that I made was that last year, [Oscar] Piastri was leading [for] McLaren at this stage of the season. And if McLaren put everything on Piastri, Max Verstappen would have been champion.
"But for sure, at one stage, you have to take a decision. But I think it was too early to take a decision before Monza. Now we have time to discuss with the guys."
Hamilton trails championship leader Kimi Antonelli by 76 points, with Leclerc 112 off Antonelli - and a maximum total of 258 available over the rest of the season.

relatedItems.titleZh: 安东内利与梅赛德斯包揽卡塔尔大奖赛练习赛
relatedItems.summaryZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Antonelli and Mercedes sweep Qatar GP practice
detailZh: 基米·安东内利在卡塔尔大奖赛FP3练习赛中连续三次夺冠，梅赛德斯竞争对手似乎在争夺最佳非梅赛德斯车队，红牛在第三次练习赛中取得第三名。
在排位赛前的20分钟内，练习赛中的圈数非常少。似乎很少有车手能在他们的第一次排位赛中取得更好的成绩。
安东内利的队友乔治·拉塞尔在第二阶段的表现中保持了领先，尽管他在著名的14号弯角发生了一次打滑，那里的地板损坏总是令人担忧，这使安东内利得以缩小到落后0.017秒。
但在第三次尝试中，安东内利全速前进，逆转了排名，领先拉塞尔0.249秒，这个成绩无人能及。
梅赛德斯的车手在任何时刻都落后了半秒左右，红牛车队的马克斯·维斯塔潘在练习结束时排名第三，落后安东内利0.510秒。
维斯塔潘的队友伊萨克·哈德贾排名第四，领先略有提升的法拉利车手查尔斯·勒克莱尔，勒克莱尔在周五的比赛中表现不佳，非常悲观。
勒克莱尔的队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿排名第九，抱怨赛车转向不足，并要求增加前翼角度以避免提前进站。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂在最后一次性能测试跑之前排名第三，但在第六和第七位时被麦凯轮车队的兰多·诺里斯超越，最终排名下降。
皮亚斯特里是众多抱怨转向不足的车手之一。
小红牛在周五表现得非常乐观，并在FP3练习中领跑中游，Arvid Lindblad排名第八，劳森排名第十，领先其中游对手两十分。
阿尔派恩落后小红牛很多，小红牛在车队积分榜上领先Enstone车队27分，争夺第五名。加斯利在FP3练习中排名第14，队友科拉平托排名第16。
科拉平托在最后阶段幸运地避开了高速移动的斯特罗尔，这一事件将在练习结束后进行调查。
在劳森和加斯利之间是奥迪和哈斯车队的奥利·贝尔曼，他的队友拉斐尔·卡马拉排名第15。
费尔南多·阿隆索超越了两辆威廉姆斯赛车，为阿斯顿·马丁赢得了第17名。
凯迪拉克车队以瓦尔特里·博塔斯领先近0.7秒的成绩，排在最后一名塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯之前。
第17名 费尔南多·阿隆索（阿斯顿·马丁）+2.696秒
detailEn: Kimi Antonelli completed a hat-trick of practice sweeps in FP3 for the Qatar Grand Prix, as Mercedes' rivals appear to be fighting for the best of the rest with Red Bull taking that honour in third practice.
Very few laps were turned in the first 20 minutes or so, before qualifying runs. It appeared that few drivers could improve on their first qualifying efforts.

Antonelli's team-mate George Russell set the early pace and maintained that lead after the second performance runs despite a wide moment through the notorious Turn 14 - where floor damage is always a worry - and that allowed Antonelli to close in to just 0.017s behind.
But on the third attempts, Antonelli turned on the afterburners to flip the order and lead Russell by 0.249s, which would not be beaten.
Mercedes' challengers were regularly around half a second down at any given point, with Red Bull's Max Verstappen taking third at the end of the session, 0.510s adrift of Antonelli.
Verstappen's team-mate Isack Hadjar took fourth ahead of the slightly improved Ferrari of Charles Leclerc, who was very pessimistic after Friday's running.
Leclerc's team-mate Lewis Hamilton was down in ninth, complaining that the car was not turning in sufficiently and asking for more front wing angle to avoid understeer.
Oscar Piastri had been third before the last performance run attempt, but was jumped by McLaren team-mate Lando Norris as they ran sixth and seventh, shuffled down the order by the end.
Piastri was another of the many drivers complaining of understeer.
Racing Bulls was extremely bullish on Friday and did head the midfield in FP3 with Arvid Lindblad in eighth and Liam Lawson in 10th, two tenths clear of its midfield rivals.

Alpine was well behind Racing Bulls, which is 27 points ahead of the Enstone team in the chase for fifth in the constructors' standings. Pierre Gasly finished 14th and team-mate Franco Colapinto 16th in FP3.
Colapinto was lucky to avoid a slow-moving Lance Stroll at high speed in the closing stages and that incident will be investigated after the session.
Between Lawson and Gasly were the Audis and Haas driver Ollie Bearman, whose team-mate Rafael Camara finished 15th.
Fernando Alonso cleared both Williams to take 17th for Aston Martin.
Cadillac anchored the order with Valtteri Bottas nearly 0.7s ahead of last-place Sergio Perez.
17 Fernando Alonso (Aston Martin) +2.696s
keyPointsZh: 梅赛德斯竞争对手在练习赛中落后梅赛德斯约半秒。
keyPointsEn: Mercedes' challengers were around half a second behind at any given point.

relatedItems.titleZh: 韩泰启动F1轮胎测试并接触车队，准备竞标2029年供应合同
relatedItems.summaryZh: 韩泰已启动F1轮胎测试计划并与车队展开谈判，准备竞标从2029年起成为F1官方轮胎供应商。F1当前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。
relatedItems.originalTitle: Hankook emerges with serious F1 tyre supply push
relatedItems.summaryEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid to become the official F1 tyre supplier from 2029. F1's current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028.
detailZh: 据The Race了解，韩泰已启动一项F1轮胎测试计划，并与车队展开谈判，为竞标从2029年起成为大奖赛官方供应商做准备。
F1目前与倍耐力的合同持续到2028年底。此前，这家意大利公司击败普利司通的竞争性报价，赢得了F1最近一次招标合同，覆盖2025至2027年。
今年6月，在国际汽联行使选择权后，其合同又延长了一个赛季。
然而，从2029年起，国际汽联将启动新的招标程序，届时似乎将出现新的竞争，以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
据了解，倍耐力希望先等待看到招标细节，然后再决定是否参与竞标，以延长其自2011年以来的当前合约期，而普利司通长期以来一直在评估重返F1的可能性，其代表已出席过多场比赛。
然而，现在有消息显示，韩泰也准备加入竞争，并且一直在暗中加大自身的努力。
该公司的代表被发现出现在最近的拉斯维加斯大奖赛上，据了解，这是他们继9月前往马德里之后，今年第二次造访F1比赛。
据The Race了解，韩泰利用这些行程会见了大多数车队，并与老板、首席执行官和其他高级管理人员讨论了计划。
然而，前往各地观看比赛——其中还包括2025年在中国、日本和新加坡举行的赛事——只是其为2029年做准备的努力的一方面。
据了解，韩泰已在公司内部组建了一支44人的专项工作组，为进入F1做准备。
除了投入研发能力和模拟器运行之外，该公司今年还使用一辆改装的F2同级测试车完成了两次F1轮胎开发测试，以评估潜在的轮胎结构以及不同配方。
第三次测试已安排用于研发其雨地轮胎，该公司希望这也能帮助其开发出一款具有更窄水雾羽流的轮胎，以减少湿地条件下造成的能见度问题。
韩泰也在努力进行生产和制造规划，以满足任何轮胎招标合同下供应F1、F2和F3轮胎所需。
韩泰对国际汽联的赛事当然并不陌生，这家韩国公司已经是世界拉力锦标赛的官方轮胎供应商，并且刚刚结束了对电动方程式锦标赛的供应，而普利司通将在即将到来的赛季接替。今年早些时候，韩泰还被指定为该管理机构的全球合作伙伴。
2029年之后的新F1轮胎招标期几乎肯定会涵盖向下一个规则时代的过渡，F1正着眼于更轻、更灵活的新赛车，以配合从2030年开始改用V8动力单元。
这些计划还将包括一种新的轮胎设计，该设计将比目前的18英寸设计略微减小车轮尺寸。
detailEn: Hankook has begun a Formula 1 tyre testing programme and opened talks with teams as it prepares to bid on becoming grand prix racing’s official supplier from 2029, The Race has learned.

F1’s current contract with Pirelli runs until the end of 2028, after the Italian company won F1’s most recent tender deal, which covered the period from 2025-2027, against a rival bid from Bridgestone.
Its contract was extended by a further season in June this year after an option was taken up by the FIA.
From 2029, however, a new tender process is set to be launched by the FIA and there looks set to be fresh competition to secure the right to be the official F1 supplier.

It is understood that Pirelli wants to wait to see details of the tender before deciding if it enters the fray to extend its current spell which stretches back to 2011, while Bridgestone has long evaluated an F1 return with representatives having attended races.
However, it has now emerged that Hankook is ready to throw its hat into the ring too and has been secretly ramping up its own efforts.
Representatives of the company were spotted at the recent Las Vegas Grand Prix, which was understood to have been their second visit to an F1 race this year following a trip to Madrid in September.
The Race understands that Hankook has used these trips to meet a majority of teams and discuss plans with bosses, CEOs and other senior executives.
The trips to races, which also included visits to events in China, Japan and Singapore in 2025, are only one side of its efforts to get ready for 2029, however.
It is understood that Hankook has already committed a 44-person task force within the company to prepare for an F1 entry.

Beyond committing research and development capability plus simulator running, it has this year completed two development tests for F1 rubber using a modified F2-equivalent-mule car to evaluate potential construction as well as different compounds.

A third test has been scheduled to work on its wet-weather rubber, which it hopes can also help it develop a tyre that features a narrower spray plume to reduce visibility problems caused in wet conditions.
Hankook is also working hard on production and manufacturing planning that would be required to supply F1, F2 and F3 tyres that would come under the umbrella of any tyre tender contract.

Hankook is certainly no stranger to FIA competition, with the South Korean company already the official tyre supplier to the World Rally Championship and has just ended its supply to Formula E where Bridgestone is taking over for the upcoming season. Earlier this year Hankook was also named as a global partner of the governing body.

The period of the new F1 tyre tender beyond 2029 will almost certainly cover the transition to the next rules era, with F1 setting sights on new lighter and nimbler cars to coincide with the switch to V8 power units from 2030.
The plans are also set to include a new tyre design, which is set to reduce wheel size slightly from the current 18-inch design.
keyPointsZh: 倍耐力在击败普利司通的竞争性报价后赢得2025至2027年的F1轮胎供应合同，今年6月国际汽联行使选择权将合同延长一个赛季。
国际汽联将从2029年起启动新的招标程序，届时预计将出现新的竞争以争夺F1官方供应商资格。
